integrity: The exact 240-entry integer certificate and 92-bit witness are embedded in full; a standalone Python standard-library checker reconstructs 330 inequalities and all witness factors. Scientific arguments remain subject to independent review.
limitations: Exact binary order-eight cyclic maximum only; no classification of extremizers or assertions about other orders, alphabets, or linear words. No claim of historical priority beyond material examined; an unindexed equivalent could exist.
title: Sharp period 92 for binary orientable cycles of order eight
